title: ETH Whale's Perfect Exit
description: A whale sold 8,000 ETH 48 hours before a 30% crash. Was it insider knowledge or pattern recognition?
result: 8,000 ETH sold at $3,800 before crash to $2,660

steps.output: +5 paths from DeFi interactions, 2 bidirectional links

events.description: On-chain: whale's known contacts also moving funds to CEX
Whale moves remaining 6,000 ETH to Binance over 24h

agent_reasoning.reasoning: 2,000 ETH moved to Binance. First batch. Likely limit sell orders placed. Whale has done this pattern 3 times before.
Network effect: whale's known associates also exiting. Suggests coordinated risk-off. High conviction signal.
Full position exit in 24h is aggressive. Whale typically sells in tranches over weeks. This urgency suggests strong conviction in downside.
Could be coincidence. Large holders rebalance regularly. The crash had macro catalysts (Fed announcement) unrelated to this whale.

stages.name: Deliberation
stages.trigger_reason: Max spread > 30% between Behavioral (85%) and Skeptic (40%)

challenges.challenge: Whale's 3 previous identical patterns all preceded 20%+ drops. Historical accuracy: 100%. Coincidence is not a strategy.
The urgency of the exit (24h vs usual weeks) is itself a signal. Behavior deviated from baseline.
Network analysis shows 4 connected wallets all exiting simultaneously. This is coordinated.

responses.response: Fair points on pattern history and network effect. Adjusting from 40% to 55%. Still maintain macro catalyst was primary driver.
Pattern history is strong evidence. Maintaining 78%.
Behavioral deviation is the strongest signal. Adjusting to 88%.

stages.ruling: Strong convergence on informed trading thesis. Pattern history, network analysis, and behavioral deviation all align. Skeptic's macro point acknowledged but doesn't explain the precision. Final: 82.4%

stages.name: Report Generation
stages.conclusion: This whale demonstrates high-conviction informed trading with a perfect track record on ETH exits. The coordinated network exit and behavioral deviation strongly suggest access to non-public information or superior pattern recognition. Recommended action: track this whale's movements as a leading indicator.
